s.note: snow days in the Colorado mountains
s.how: Fill 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and 150g cheese, butter the outsides and toast in a pan for 3 minutes a side. Cut into triangles.
Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes and tuck into 8 soft buns. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce so everyone builds their own. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: the family Christmas Jack keeps missing
m.how: Season a 1.5kg beef topside and roast at 200C for 1 hour with 1kg potatoes. Rest 15 minutes, make gravy with the pan juices and 300ml stock and carve.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Ice with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar and roll in coconut.

d.note: a snowy night in the mountains
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming and whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs and serve straight away. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
